status: Exploratory after all 48 expression libraries were examined in CODE3 and CODE4; no new blinded test
question: Can a fixed rule select useful immediate-subset donors without reading the expression values of the current target?
allowed_inputs: For each target: 33 order<=2 libraries plus its immediate proper-subset donors, deduplicated. Current target and other high-order cells excluded with read_csv(usecols).
filter: Mean author-normalized count >=10 in the 33 control/single/pair libraries only; expected 21495 genes
basis: Unscaled control-anchored SVD of 11 lower-order condition means. Rank2 primary, rank1 sensitivity; no tuning.
donors: Immediate proper subsets by factorial bits: three pair conditions for a triple target, four triples for the four-way target
scores: Mean squared control-centered raw effect, rank-r common projection and residual projection; ascending scores, lexicographic condition-name tie break
prediction: Selected models predict full selected-donor centroids except explicit common_low2_residual_only. Half shrink is CT + 0.5*(all-donor mean-CT).
evaluation: Every model/rank/target: mean and each RNA-library MSE, MAE, common-component MSE, residual-component MSE. No P values, gene bootstraps or pooled significance.
stability: Omit each candidate donor library one at a time, hold original filter/control/basis fixed, recompute that donor mean and rerank six selection rules. Report membership changes, not confidence intervals. Target values unused.
separation: Save numerical predictions and hashes before a separate evaluation command. This is code-level input separation after discovery, not new blind validation.
limitations: All expression values were already examined; no donor count, rank, filter, shrinkage or model is tuned after this comparison.
Pair donors for triple targets contributed to the lower-order basis; triple donors for the four-way target did not. Tasks are not identically distributed independent validations.
Single/pair benchmarks use 33 libraries. Four-way donor predictors also use observed triples; this is not an equal-information algorithm contest.
Author normalization may couple all 48 libraries. Current-target exclusion does not provide independent preprocessing.
The raw squared score equals common plus residual squared scores. Identical donor selection and prediction cannot establish a distinct useful selector.
Projection residual is not a gene-wise factorial interaction contrast; it can contain lower-order effects outside the retained basis.
